mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline consistently over the past month, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% in the next month signals heightened labor market uncertainty, reducing investor confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross above 4.5% in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 105 in the next month signals robust supply-side growth, stimulating demand and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 105 in the next month
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not exceed 105 in the next month, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in INDPRO signals a dual easing and supply-side expansion, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases month-over-month AND INDPRO increases month-over-month
failure_condition: If the proxies do not move in opposite directions as specified, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPIAUCSL above 240 in the next month signals accelerating inflation, prompting market concerns and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 240 in the next month
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL does not exceed 240 in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST and GDPC1 indicates robust demand growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and GDPC1 increase month-over-month
failure_condition: If either proxy does not increase month-over-month, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in FEDFUNDS signals impending monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not rise >0.5% in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in UNRATE above 4.7% in the next month signals heightened labor market instability, reducing investor confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.7% in the next month
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not exceed 4.7% in the next month, or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
